name: Owariasahi (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Owariasahi city emblem in green: a ring of three leaf-like segments around a white disc.
history: Municipal flag of Owariasahi, a city in Aichi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 5 October 1957.

features.role: Owariasahi city emblem — a ring of three leaf-like segments around a white disc
